tip.theta: Put the tip of your tongue lightly between your teeth and blow air, no voice. Do not say "t", "s" or "f".
tip.eth: Like /θ/ (tongue between the teeth) but with voice. Do not say "d" or "z".
tip.sh: Round your lips, pull the tongue back and blow a long "sh". Do not say "s".
tip.ch: A "ch" burst with rounder lips, ending in a "sh" breath (cheese).
tip.r: Curl the tongue tip up without touching the roof of the mouth, lips slightly round. Do not say "l" or "z".
tip.l: Tongue tip touches the ridge behind the upper teeth, air flows around the sides; even at the end of a word (ball).
tip.ng: The back of the tongue touches the soft palate and air goes through the nose; do not add a clear "g".
tip.ih: A short, relaxed vowel with the mouth slightly open; shorter than the "ee" in sheep.
tip.ee: A long vowel with flat lips; longer than /ɪ/ (sheep vs ship).
tip.ae: Open the mouth wide with the tongue low, between "a" and "e" (cat).
tip.uh: Medium-open mouth, very short, like an open "uh" (cup); not a long "a".
tip.aw: Rounded lips, long, like an open "o" (law).
tip.oo: Short with slightly rounded lips, unlike the long "oo" in food (book).
tip.er: Tongue in the middle, lips not rounded, long (bird); do not add a hard "r".
tip.schwa: A very short, light "uh" with no stress (about).
tip.end_s: Final /s/: end with a clear "s" hiss, do not swallow it (cats, books).
tip.end_z: Final /z/: like "s" but voiced (dogs, beds); do not drop it.
tip.end_t: Final /t/: touch the ridge with the tongue and release lightly; do not swallow it (cat, walked).
tip.end_d: Final /d/: tongue touches the ridge, voiced; do not drop it (bed, played).
tip.end_k: Final /k/: back of the tongue touches the palate, then a light release; do not swallow it (book, week).
tip.end_p: Final /p/: close the lips then release a light puff; do not swallow it (stop, help).
tip.v: Top teeth touch the lower lip and the sound is voiced (very); not "b".
tip.f: Top teeth touch the lower lip and you blow air, no voice (fish).
